dev.//: Vite dev server for the concept explorer at localhost:55173. The concept surfaces run on the in-file sample corpus and need no backend; only the Embedding view talks to atlas-api (use dev:live for that).

build.//: Typecheck (tsc -b) then bundle to dist/. Add build-time one-shots (e.g. a future GraphQL 'codegen' target) to dependsOn so they run before the bundle.

preview.//: Serve the production build from dist/ (run build first).

dev:live.//: Dev server wired for the live Embedding view: ensures atlas-api's Postgres is up first (cross-project dependsOn atlas-api:db). Start the GraphQL API separately — `nx serve atlas-api` — since a long-running server cannot be a dependsOn. This is the template for future GQL/data-run dependencies: add one-shot targets and list them here.
